Describe a File for a Benchmark Release

Source: R/upload.R
benchmark_resource.Rd

Files remain separate for distributed jobs. Each results or measures file must contain only its declared DGM, method and setting. Checksums describe the exact bytes; package_version describes generation, not migration.

Usage

benchmark_resource(
  path,
  dgm_name,
  kind,
  method = NULL,
  method_setting = NULL,
  condition_ids = NULL,
  package_version = NULL,
  replacement = FALSE,
  measures = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  dependencies = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Local file path.

dgm_name

DGM name.

kind

data, results, measures, pairwise, metadata, or archive.

method

Method identifier for results/measures.

method_setting

Method setting identifier.

condition_ids

Conditions covered by the file.

package_version

Producing package version; NULL when historically unknown.

replacement

Whether the file contains replacement measures.

measures

Measures present in a wide measures file.

id

Stable logical shard identifier; defaults to DGM/kind/basename.

dependencies

Optional IDs of input assets used to compute this asset.

Value

A file descriptor for plan_benchmark_release.
